summary: The owning V3-ENV-01 design and roadmap require the installed provisioner and launcher to perform operation-bound allocation, binding, launch, scoped teardown and worker-loss recovery automatically after one-time authorized setup, without a human host-agent dependency during normal use. Installed qualification must observe normal completion and failure recovery with that channel absent, including selected provisioner-restart and supported reboot cases. Recovery preserves original identities, deadlines, export obligations and holds; safe bounded Incomplete or Unknown does not establish successful cleanup, and manual repair cannot pass an unattended case. Manual pilots, source delivery, pure fixtures and source/evidence handoffs cannot close this gate or V3-ENV-01. The cited documents record the acceptance requirement; they do not prove installed functionality, native qualification, release or adoption. Existing historical source-only and lifecycle records retain their own scope.
title: V3 normal use requires an unattended installed lifecycle
